purpose: Freeze one value-independent A5 schema before territorial unblinding. A5 is a provenance-locked remote/global feature bundle, not a model, score, risk class, alert or activation inference.
selection_rule: Include all seven basic DEM-derived morphometric quantities defined below, the three already preregistered A3 precipitation metrics, and the five already preregistered Sentinel-1 R4 primary metrics. Do not add, remove, transform, threshold or weight a feature based on its observed magnitude or territorial outcome.
missing_rule: If a stage feature is unavailable under the frozen acquisition/QA rule, retain its named slot with value=null and an explicit MISSING or UNKNOWN status. Never impute zero.
transport_rule: TRANSPORT_BLOCKED remains UNKNOWN_NOT_MISSING and cannot be converted to a numerical value.

A3_ANTECEDENT_7D_MM.time_basis: 7 local calendar days ending at target local 00:00

A4_OPTICAL_CHANGE_PRIMARY.rule: null until an optical change feature and acceptance rule are frozen before unblinding

SMAP_SOIL_MOISTURE_PRIMARY.rule: null when product is unavailable for the frozen window; no imputation

a5_hash_rule: Canonical JSON is UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':') over the ordered feature entries represented as a list of {id,value,status,unit}. SHA-256 of those canonical bytes is the A5 feature_vector_sha256.
next_gate_after_a5: Keep territorial evidence sealed for the anchor while building the same frozen schema for independently sampled multipista windows. Unblind only according to the blind sampling contract; serious modeling remains closed until a minimum multi-basin case/control dataset exists.
